prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 40s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese poised refined beauty milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and natural skin with visible pores, mid 40s, a polished silver low bun with a few loose strands, wet-look black gradient eyeshadow with a chrome highlight on the lids, a graphic black liner, sleek lashes, high-shine black vinyl lips like polished glass, a cool matte contour, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a hot-pink coloured contact lens with a radiating sunburst iris pattern, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a deep cobalt-blue coloured contact lens with a thick dark outer ring and round natural pupils, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, a faraway, unfocused gaze drifting just past the camera, lips softly parted, a dreamy, ethereal expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): extreme siren eyes: very long, very narrow, strongly upturned eyes with the outer corners lifted high and stretched far out toward the temples in a long, razor-sharp upswept cat flick, a pronounced catlike inner point, thick smoky black kohl liner on the waterline and an extremely long, straight, razor-sharp wing reaching toward her temples, heavy dark lashes, in deep amber contact lenses with a big visible iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; her nose: a high, straight, refined, surgically sculpted nose: a tall, slim, straight bridge, a narrow, pointed, projecting tip and clearly narrow nostril wings with slim, neat nostrils; her jawline and chin: an extreme, razor-sharp V-line: the cheeks taper in a long, smooth, straight diagonal from the ears down to a small, narrow, pointed chin, a very slim lower face with a sharply defined sculpted jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about seventy-nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; two small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; five small hoop or studs along the edge of the upper lip; eight small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; five small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit fourteen pieces above the lobe: seven classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, four studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and three in the conch and tragus; ten small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; eight small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Fine chains link the pieces: from the upper ear hoop on each side a delicate chain swags across the cheek to the ring around the nostril wing on the same side, passing well below the eye and clear of the lips, and one more fine chain hangs in a soft curve under the jaw from one ear to the other; the chains are thin enough that every piece and her whole face stay clearly visible. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly ten separate massive weights, each of a different shape, all of them blackened rough cast iron with a hammered, uneven surface, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal: on the left ear a hammer head on a shortest chain, a ship's anchor on a shortest chain, a round bell on a short chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a short chain, a miniature anvil on a medium chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a long chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a longer chain, a square-sided cowbell on a longer chain, a cube-shaped block on a longest chain; on the right ear a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a shortest chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, a round bell on a short chain, a cube-shaped block on a short chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a medium chain, a miniature anvil on a long chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, a ship's anchor on a longer chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a longer chain, a hammer head on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
